title: Evaluating Bias and Fairness in Gender-Neutral Pretrained Vision-and-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring intrinsic bias using a Masked Language Modeling (MLM) task to evaluate the co-occurrence of gendered terms and context words, and measuring extrinsic bias using a directional bias amplification metric (BiasAmp) along with group disparity on downstream vision-and-language tasks like Visual Question Answering (VQA), NLVR2, and image-text retrieval.
